Scientific Glossary

Key definitions for math and physics across PhysicaX.

Showing 10 of 10 entries.
Dimensionless number
Ratio of physical quantities with no units, used to compare regimes.
Math
Reynolds number
Re = ρ v L / μ, compares inertia to viscosity in fluid flow.
Fluids
Strouhal number
St = f L / v, relates vortex shedding frequency to speed.
Fluids
Entropy
State function measuring dispersal of energy; ΔS ≥ ∫ δQ/T.
Thermo
Helmholtz free energy
F = U − TS, energy available for work at constant T,V.
Thermo
CFL condition
Δt ≤ Δx / c to keep explicit PDE schemes stable.
Numerics
Lyapunov exponent
Average exponential rate of divergence of nearby trajectories.
Chaos
Phase portrait
Plot of state variables showing trajectories in phase space.
Dynamics
Poincaré section
Discrete sampling of a continuous system at fixed phase.
Chaos
Eigenvalue
λ such that A v = λ v; determines linear stability.
Linear Algebra
